title: Monkey holding a balloon
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- balloon string -->
  <path d='M62 34 Q58 48 54 58' stroke='#ffd166' stroke-width='1.6' fill='none'/>
  <!-- balloon -->
  <ellipse cx='66' cy='22' rx='13' ry='15' fill='#ff4d6d'/>
  <ellipse cx='62' cy='17' rx='4' ry='5' fill='#ff8fa3'/>
  <path d='M66 37 l-3 4 l6 0 z' fill='#c9184a'/>
  <!-- monkey body -->
  <ellipse cx='46' cy='72' rx='18' ry='20' fill='#a0522d'/>
  <ellipse cx='46' cy='75' rx='11' ry='13' fill='#f2c79b'/>
  <!-- tail -->
  <path d='M28 80 Q12 82 14 66 Q16 58 24 62' stroke='#8b4513' stroke-width='4' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- legs -->
  <ellipse cx='36' cy='92' rx='7' ry='5' fill='#8b4513'/>
  <ellipse cx='56' cy='92' rx='7' ry='5' fill='#8b4513'/>
  <!-- left arm holding string -->
  <path d='M34 66 Q44 56 54 58' stroke='#a0522d' stroke-width='7' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- right arm -->
  <path d='M58 68 Q66 72 64 80' stroke='#a0522d' stroke-width='7' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx='46' cy='48' r='16' fill='#a0522d'/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <circle cx='31' cy='45' r='6' fill='#a0522d'/>
  <circle cx='31' cy='45' r='3' fill='#f2c79b'/>
  <circle cx='61' cy='45' r='6' fill='#a0522d'/>
  <circle cx='61' cy='45' r='3' fill='#f2c79b'/>
  <!-- face patch -->
  <ellipse cx='46' cy='52' rx='11' ry='10' fill='#f2c79b'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='41' cy='46' r='2.6' fill='#3b1f0b'/>
  <circle cx='51' cy='46' r='2.6' fill='#3b1f0b'/>
  <circle cx='41.8' cy='45.2' r='0.9' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='51.8' cy='45.2' r='0.9' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- nose -->
  <ellipse cx='46' cy='53' rx='3.5' ry='2.5' fill='#8b4513'/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M40 58 Q46 63 52 58' stroke='#8b4513' stroke-width='1.6' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
</svg>
